title: 🌟🙏✨ Just Wrapped Up an Inspirational Bible Study Session at Weegols Garden! ✨🙏🌟
paragraphs: 🌟🙏✨ Just Wrapped Up an Inspirational Bible Study Session at Weegols Garden! ✨🙏🌟

I am absolutely thrilled to share the incredible experience we had today at Weegols Garden during our Bible study. The topic was "GOD is always on time," and the insights we gained were truly enlightening! 📖🙌

First and foremost, I want to extend my heartfelt gratitude to my cousin Jeremiah Betia Calo for opening the doors of his wonderful establishment and graciously allowing us to use the space. His generosity and support in spreading God's word is truly remarkable. 🏡🙏

I'd also like to take a moment to express my appreciation for my bro Mayor Dr Edward U. Chan, whose unwavering support and understanding have been invaluable on this spiritual journey. Your dedication to helping me fulfill my assignment in God's Kingdom is a true blessing. 🤝❤️
As we reflect on today's Bible study, let us remember that God's timing is always perfect, and He works in mysterious ways to align our lives with His divine plan. 🕊️⏰
Let's continue to grow together in God's love and light! 🙏❤️
May God bless Jeremiah Calo, Dr. Edward Chan, and each one of you abundantly. 🌟🙌
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)
